purpose: Own the single deterministic diagnostic precedence order over the Result enum and the construction of ordered, stable, payload-free code sequences with at most one bounded numeric locator.
interfaces: Diagnostic: codes() const -> bounded Result sequence; locator() const -> std::optional<std::uint32_t>
constexpr std::strong_ordering compare(Result a, Result b) (deterministic ordering)
inputs: One or more Result codes (first applicable failure, highest precedence first) and an optional numeric locator.
outputs: An ordered Diagnostic value (bounded code sequence plus optional locator) and precedence comparisons.
state: None. The diagnostic is an immutable value produced from inputs; the precedence order is a constexpr table.
errors: No runtime errors; structural static checks assert that Diagnostic holds only enumerable codes and a numeric locator.
invariants: Precedence order is fixed: handle failures before context, time, action, permit, quota, and capacity failures.
The code sequence is bounded (capacity 8) and the locator is at most one bounded numeric value.
No string, item, observation, or free-form content field exists.
The same input yields the same code sequence across runs and builds.
concurrency: Not applicable; diagnostics are immutable values with no shared state.

unit_cases.precondition: A single failure Result is provided.
unit_cases.stimulus: Construct a Diagnostic from the single code.
unit_cases.expected: codes() has one entry equal to that code; codes().front() is the primary Result.

unit_cases.precondition: A foreign handle, a stale generation, and an expired permit all apply.
unit_cases.stimulus: Construct a Diagnostic from the multi-failure set.
unit_cases.expected: Ordered sequence is [ForeignHandle]; handle precedence wins.

unit_cases.precondition: An expired permit and an undefined action both apply.
unit_cases.stimulus: Construct a Diagnostic from the multi-failure set.
unit_cases.expected: Ordered sequence is [PermitExpired]; time precedes action.

unit_cases.precondition: A permitted action is attempted from a terminal state.
unit_cases.stimulus: Construct a Diagnostic for the terminal-state failure.

unit_cases.precondition: More than eight failure codes are accumulated.
unit_cases.stimulus: Construct a Diagnostic from an over-long input set.
unit_cases.expected: The sequence is capped at capacity 8 and does not overflow.

unit_cases.precondition: An identical multi-failure input is constructed twice.
unit_cases.stimulus: Build two Diagnostics from the same inputs.

static_checks.expected: Diagnostic members are only a bounded Result array and a numeric locator; no std::string/payload member.
clean (no diagnostic): codes() and locator() are const member functions.
clean (no diagnostic): Result parameters are passed by value (enum) only.
clean: header formatted with no diff.
